findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_wafer_pricing" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Returns 300mm wafer price ranges (min/avg/max USD), defect density, NRE/mask-set cost, and node maturity for: tsmc-n3, tsmc-n5, tsmc-n7, tsmc-n16, tsmc-28, sams…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_hbm_qualification, get_foundry_allocation, get_foundry_economics, get_market_intelligence, get_forecasts, get_wfe_signals, get_fab_events, get_policy_events, search, fetch · Private data: get_accelerator_costs, get_hbm_market_data, get_wafer_pricing, get_hbm_qualification, get_foundry_allocation, get_foundry_economics, get_recent_changes, get_market_intelligence, get_benchmark_history, get_forecasts, get_track_record, get_policy_events, search, fetch · Public sink: calculate_chip_cost, get_hbm_market_data, get_hbm_qualification, get_foundry_allocation, get_foundry_economics, get_fab_capacity, get_bottlenecks, get_fab_events · Destructive: get_market_dataset.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_hbm_qualification, get_foundry_allocation, get_foundry_economics, get_market_intelligence, get_forecasts, get_wfe_signals, get_fab_events, get_policy_events, search, fetch · Private data: get_accelerator_costs, get_hbm_market_data, get_wafer_pricing, get_hbm_qualification, get_foundry_allocation, get_foundry_economics, get_recent_changes, get_market_intelligence, get_benchmark_history, get_forecasts, get_track_record, get_policy_events, search, fetch · Public sink: calculate_chip_cost, get_hbm_market_data, get_hbm_qualification, get_foundry_allocation, get_foundry_economics, get_fab_capacity, get_bottlenecks, get_fab_events · Destructive: get_market_dataset

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
